dialogue.coach_intro:
Don't collect exercises. Build a session.

Explore the three chest stations. Learn how pressing and isolation complement each other, then build your first chest day.
dialogue.coach_after_discovery: Presses and isolation serve different roles. Discover all three stations, build your session, then return to a station for one working set.
dialogue.coach_after_training:
You built a session and felt the effort. Training adds fatigue and uses hydration.

Finish the session at the Recovery Corner: drink water, then use the mat.
dialogue.coach_completion: A good session includes recovery. You now understand how pressing and isolation fit together. Keep that knowledge with you.
